title: Solution Consultant
job_description:
Solutions Consultant

Professional Services · Austin, TX or Remote (US) · Full-time, exempt

About Dooap

Dooap is a cloud-native accounts payable automation solution built specifically for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and AX 2012. A SaaS web application delivered from the Microsoft Azure Cloud, Dooap seamlessly integrates with D365 Finance ERP. Our modern technology stack (Azure, .NET Core) and agile development methods ensure the best user experience with all the functionalities any organization requires. Our design principles have always revolved around usability, performance, and transparency, giving users total visibility and control over their accounts payable process. We have grown into a trusted name in the digital finance process automation space, serving both U.S. and international companies.

Overview

As a Solutions Consultant (SC) at Dooap, you will lead the Discovery, Implementation, and Testing & Training phases for multiple concurrent projects across a range of industries. You will own task prioritization, the hands-on building of solutions, and client communication while meeting or exceeding Dooap’s standard Customer Service SLA. The role suits someone who enjoys client-facing work as much as collaborating with an emotionally intelligent internal team spanning the U.S. and Finland.

You bring your “A” game to every meeting and are energized by client conversations on video calls. You will drive quality and client satisfaction by qualifying client needs, gathering requirements, identifying opportunities, and becoming the client’s trusted advisor and subject matter expert — making every client feel like a priority as you convert their current Accounts Payable process to Dooap’s standard product offering.

Key Responsibilities

Project Delivery & Implementation

Lead and manage the Discovery, Implementation, and Testing/Training phases of each project
Implement project solutions and manage client expectations and feedback professionally
Perform mid-level backend configuration to fit the Dooap standard product to the customer's AP process requirements
Schedule and prioritize tasks across multiple concurrent projects

Client Engagement & Communication

Explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical end users, both verbally and in writing
Maintain composure and a constructive tone during challenging client meetings
Build client confidence through responsive, engaged communication and visible investment in their success
Manage moderate to complex customer issues and the overall client relationship with a customer-first approach
Collaborate across the U.S. and Finland teams to drive strong collective performance

Solution Design & Product Collaboration

Architect customer solutions and design interfaces within the Accounts Payable space
Challenge the customer, as a trusted consultant and SME, when it comes to product development and best practices
Work closely with the product development team to enhance product features based on customer feedback
Recognize when to escalate issues and route them to the right internal team

Client Enablement & Training

Lead the Testing & Training phase of each project, including UAT coordination and key-user training for the client’s AP team
Create and maintain client-facing solution documentation, including:
Configuration and design decisions captured during Discovery
Process guides for the client’s AP workflow in Dooap
Understand and implement release-related updates relevant to the client’s configuration
Deliver product walkthroughs and demonstrations that show clients how Dooap standard functionality fits their AP process
Identify recurring client questions and turn them into reusable training materials and best-practice guidance

Process Improvement

Analyze delivery patterns across projects to identify opportunities to streamline the Discovery-to-go-live process
Provide structured feedback to Product Management on enhancement requests and usability gaps surfaced during implementations
Contribute to improving Professional Services templates, tools, and delivery methodology

Required Skills & Qualifications

3+ years of experience in software implementation, consulting, or professional services — ideally with an ERP or SaaS product
Hands-on experience configuring or implementing business software for external clients
Experienced in scheduling, prioritizing tasks, and managing workload for multiple projects at once
Exceptional written and verbal communication — able to convey complex information clearly, concisely, and with credibility
Genuine interest in scoping and crafting technical solutions in an Accounts Payable space
Excellent self-learning skills and ability to learn quickly with minimal guidance

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management
Knowledge of Accounts Payable processes and best practices
Experience working with cloud-native products (e.g., Microsoft Azure)
Working knowledge of SQL and comfort working in databases
Experience with EDI and XML documents
Power BI navigation and development

What You Bring

Come every day with an attitude of gratitude and success — a self-motivated, independent thinker who thrives without micromanagement, sets their own pace, owns their projects, and asks questions when they need them answered
A proactive, independent consultant with high attention to detail and a passion for working with clients
A natural problem solver with a customer-first attitude
Superior understanding of cause-and-effect relationships and the ability to demonstrate logical thought processes
Willingness to occasionally work outside standard business hours to collaborate with our development team in Finland

What We Offer

We believe the key to happy customers is happy employees. That’s why we aim to offer a fun and relaxed work environment that promotes personal and professional growth.

100% remote work environment
Flexible working hours
15 days PTO + 14 paid U.S. holidays
Competitive salary
Performance bonuses
Equity or profit-sharing participation
Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Health savings and flexible spending accounts (HSA/FSA)
401(k) with employer match
Life, AD&D, and short- and long-term disability insurance
Home office stipend
Company-provided laptop and accessories
Internet and phone reimbursement
Annual learning and certification budget, including Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Azure certifications
Team events and annual company retreats

Equal Employment Opportunity

Dooap is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

Pay: $90,000.00 - $100,000.00 per year

Benefits:

401(k)
Dental insurance
Health insurance
Life insurance
Paid time off
Parental leave
Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote
